title: Tax-residency and FATCA information - support procedure
content: The Call Sense Bank demo routes declaration questions to a configured checklist and a human reviewer. This assistant does not infer a customer's tax status or provide tax advice; consult the relevant institution or a qualified adviser for real declarations.
